source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, Attached is a draft logo created by AI (obviously we were just tinkering about with chat gpt). However, we are looking for fresh original ideas (hence our proposal) but we do like those colours as they match the look and feel of the Global Dough truck. Our company name is 'Global Dough' so we don't want the word 'truck' in the logo. The 'truck' element is just one part of the business . In other words 'Global Dough' (the business for which we need a logo) will be operating a mobile catering truck, selling food online and possibly selling to other caterers/kitchens. So that's why the company name is just 'Global Dough' but the strapline remains the same. Happy to chat through anything before you accept the offer?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi, oops I thought I’d got back to you!

We’d like to go agreed with that final version (above) - rev4-02. Thank you!

I’m assuming the logo would be with and without the black box (as a black box won’t work for everything)?

And we would get all colour variants you have shown?

However, I think the main logo would be the (graduated) orange ‘global’ with a black ‘dough’ and graduated orange strapline as shown in the top row of the final version.

So we just need logo guidelines and all file types to use across online, social media, on the truck itself and other hard copy materials eg pull up banners, or printed menus, uniform etc .

As the files will be large file sizes how do you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, Niki

execution.observed_behavior: Client selects final version rev4-02 and explicitly identifies its ‘global’, ‘dough’, and strapline text elements.

routing_warnings.description: The requested changes concern letterform appearance, word sizing, and strapline contrast rather than the logo's textual content.
The feedback changes typography character and colour treatment without changing the required business name or strapline.
The requested U, H, and D letterform adjustments concern visual styling rather than textual content.
